text:
Type: glass display cabinet on wooden stand
Use: displaying glassware, ceramics, books and collections; living room, dining room
Style: Scandinavian, mid-century modern, contemporary
Materials: light grey painted frame, clear glass doors and sides, dark brown wood stand
Colors: light grey, clear glass, warm dark brown
Shape: tall glass box with two see-through doors and glass sides, slim frame, small round knobs, raised on a wooden base with four square legs and stretchers, medium visual weight
Feel: airy, elegant, refined, calm
Goes with: walnut, white walls, ceramics, wool rugs; Scandinavian, mid-century or modern living and dining rooms

product.name: STOCKHOLM
product.description: Glass-door cabinet in durable materials like tempered glass, solid wood and metal.
